candidates.description: This vector represents common Thai prepositions and locative terms indicating spatial or conceptual relationships.
This vector represents common Thai linguistic sub-word tokens and character fragments centered around frequent grammatical components and prefixes.
This vector detects non-English script characters and foreign language typography.
This vector activates on a random assortment of multilingual subword tokens and numeric fragments without a cohesive semantic theme.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the consonant cluster "pl" or its phonological equivalents across various scripts.
The feature represents alphanumeric tokens and subword fragments spanning multiple languages and character sets.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai script and its specific character combinations.
This vector activates strongly for mathematical operators, arithmetic symbols, and common punctuation marks used in equations.
These tokens represent various mathematical symbols, comparative operators, and Thai script characters commonly used in conditional logic or comparison statements.
This feature vector represents numeric values associated with measurements, scores, or identifiers.
